The '''Assault on Repair Station M13''' was a mission undertaken by [[Green squad]], a [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] unit operating in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. The assault was part of [[Operation Retribution]], a series of combat operations organized by the Roughnecks' leader, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to harass [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activities across the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Assault" />

[[Green squad]] were assigned to attack [[Repair Station]] [[M13]], an Imperial facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]]. The team's orders were to harass the base, capture [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] for interrogation, steal much needed weapons and supplies, and destroy the facility if that was deemed possible. Since Operation Retribution was stretching the Roughnecks' resources to the limit, Green squad were expected to inflicte the maximum amount of damage with the least amount of risk, and to withdraw after two [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="Assault" />
